description: Takes the transcript of a spoken explanation (for example a recorded handover or a screen walkthrough, German or English) and an optional title. Removes filler words, then sorts the sentences by fixed keyword rules into numbered work steps (sequence words and action verbs such as open, click, enter, check, save, send), notes to watch out for (important, never, always, don't forget), sentences with numbers, deadlines and limits, the terms and systems that come up, and open questions. The sentences stay in the speaker's words and are only sorted. Red when fewer than three steps are found. To write meeting minutes with AI use write_meeting_minutes. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

title.description: Optional: name of the task, for example 'Monthly supplier statement reconciliation'.

name: build_guide_from_recording
title: From recording to instructions: the transcript of someone explaining a task becomes numbered steps, notes, numbers, terms and open questions
